findings.text: The company's status is active and no insolvency record is held for it by Companies House.
The confirmation statement is overdue, with the next statement due 23 October 2026 and the last one made up to 9 October 2025.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 March 2025 and the next accounts are due 31 December 2026.
The company has 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 350 (appointed 25 September 2014) and PERSON 351 (appointed 1 October 2015), and 1 other officer.
Two current persons with significant control are recorded: PERSON 353 (individual; ownership of shares 50 to 75 percent) and PERSON 354 (individual; ownership of shares 25 to 50 percent).
No charges are registered against the company.
The two current directors hold 4 other company appointments between them, 2 active and 2 dissolved, according to matched officer records.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 462 is an active company incorporated on 24 September 2014 with no insolvency record, but its confirmation statement is overdue.
